api_and_security.title: API & Security Utilities
api_and_security.description: This module provides core utilities for managing API lifecycle warnings (beta features, deprecations) and robust security features, primarily focusing on Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) protection for URL validation and HTTP client creation.

nodes.label: Warn on Beta Function Use
nodes.title: Beta Function Warning
nodes.description: Emits a warning when a function or async function marked as beta is called, ensuring users are aware of experimental features.

nodes.label: Warn on Beta Class Instance
nodes.title: Beta Class Instance Warning
nodes.description: Emits a warning when a class marked as beta is directly instantiated, indicating its experimental status.

nodes.label: Warn on Beta Property Access
nodes.title: Beta Property Access Warning
nodes.description: Emits a warning when a property marked as beta is accessed (get, set, or delete), informing users of its experimental nature.

nodes.label: Warn on Deprecated Function Use
nodes.title: Deprecated Function Warning
nodes.description: Emits a warning when a function or async function marked as deprecated is called, guiding users to newer alternatives.

nodes.label: Warn on Deprecated Class Instance
nodes.title: Deprecated Class Instance Warning
nodes.description: Emits a warning when a class marked as deprecated is directly instantiated, advising against its continued use.

nodes.label: Validate URL with DNS & Policy
nodes.title: Asynchronous URL Validation
nodes.description: Asynchronously validates a URL against SSRF policies, including DNS resolution to prevent server-side request forgery.

nodes.label: Check URL Safety (Non-throwing)
nodes.title: Safe URL Check
nodes.description: Determines if a URL is safe according to SSRF policies without raising exceptions, returning a boolean result.

nodes.label: Strict SSRF URL Validation
nodes.title: Strict SSRF Validation
nodes.description: Applies strict SSRF protection rules to a URL, disallowing private IP addresses and ensuring public access.

nodes.label: HTTPS-Only SSRF URL Validation
nodes.title: HTTPS-Only Validation
nodes.description: Validates URLs for SSRF protection, specifically enforcing the use of HTTPS protocol.

nodes.label: Relaxed SSRF URL Validation
nodes.title: Relaxed SSRF Validation
nodes.description: Applies relaxed SSRF protection rules, allowing private IP addresses while still preventing other common SSRF vectors.

nodes.label: Create SSRF-Safe Async HTTP Client
nodes.title: SSRF-Safe HTTP Client
nodes.description: Provides a factory function to create an asynchronous HTTP client (httpx.AsyncClient) with built-in SSRF protection policies.

nodes.label: External HTTP Client Library
nodes.title: HTTPX Library
nodes.description: Represents the external `httpx` library used for making asynchronous HTTP requests, integrated with SSRF protection.

groups.label: API Lifecycle Management
groups.title: API Lifecycle Management
groups.description: Handles warnings for beta features and deprecated components to guide developers on API evolution and usage.

groups.label: Security Validation & Protection
groups.title: Security Validation & Protection
groups.description: Provides mechanisms for validating URLs and creating secure HTTP clients to prevent Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks.

base_abstractions.title: Core LangChain Abstractions
base_abstractions.description: This module defines the fundamental abstract base classes and interfaces for building LangChain applications, including serializable components, composable runnables, language models, prompts, output parsers, tools, retrievers, and vector stores. It establishes the core architecture for creating flexible and extensible AI systems.

nodes.label: Serializable
nodes.title: Serializable Base Class
nodes.description: Provides a common interface for objects that can be serialized to JSON, enabling persistence and transferability across the LangChain ecosystem.

nodes.label: Runnable
nodes.title: Composable Unit of Work
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental interface for composable units of work, supporting synchronous/asynchronous invocation, batching, streaming, and various modifications for building chains.

nodes.label: RunnableSerializable
nodes.title: Serializable & Composable Unit
nodes.description: Combines the capabilities of serialization with the Runnable interface, allowing composable units to be saved, loaded, and configured at runtime.

nodes.label: RunnableEachBase
nodes.title: Apply Runnable to List Items
nodes.description: A base class for runnables that apply another runnable to each element of an input sequence, facilitating parallel processing of list inputs.

nodes.label: RunnableBindingBase
nodes.title: Bind Args/Config to Runnable
nodes.description: A base class for runnables that delegate calls to another runnable with bound arguments or configuration, creating a new runnable with modified behavior.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: Abstract Language Model Interface
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all language models (LLMs and Chat Models), providing a common interface for prompt generation, token counting, and structured output.

nodes.label: Simple Chat Model
nodes.title: Simplified Chat Model
nodes.description: A simplified implementation for chat models, primarily for backward compatibility, inheriting from BaseChatModel (which extends BaseLanguageModel).

nodes.label: LLM
nodes.title: Simplified LLM Interface
nodes.description: A simple interface for implementing custom Large Language Models (LLMs), inheriting from BaseLLM (which extends BaseLanguageModel).

nodes.label: Base Prompt Template
nodes.title: Abstract Prompt Template
nodes.description: Base class for all prompt templates, defining the interface for creating and formatting prompts, handling input variables and partial application.

nodes.label: Base Output Parser
nodes.title: Abstract Output Parser
nodes.description: Base class for parsing language model outputs into various structured formats, providing methods for parsing results and generating format instructions.

nodes.label: Base Generation Output Parser
nodes.title: Parse LLM Generations
nodes.description: A base class specifically designed to parse the raw output of LLM generations into structured formats, inheriting from BaseOutputParser.

nodes.label: Base Tool
nodes.title: Abstract Tool Interface
nodes.description: Base class for all LangChain tools, defining the interface for tools that agents can use to perform specific actions, including input validation and execution.

nodes.label: Base Retriever
nodes.title: Abstract Document Retriever
nodes.description: Abstract base class for document retrieval systems, defining the interface for retrieving relevant documents based on a query.

nodes.label: Vector Store
nodes.title: Vector Database Interface
nodes.description: An interface for vector databases, providing methods for adding, deleting, searching, and retrieving documents based on vector embeddings.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Fundamental Building Blocks
groups.description: These components provide the foundational interfaces for serialization, composable execution, and dynamic configuration within LangChain.

groups.label: Language Model Interfaces
groups.title: Abstract Language Model Definitions
groups.description: Interfaces for interacting with various types of language models, including abstract base classes for general LLMs and simplified chat models.

groups.label: Prompting & Parsing
groups.title: Prompt Construction and Output Interpretation
groups.description: Components for defining and formatting prompts, and for parsing the structured or unstructured outputs generated by language models.

groups.label: Agentic Components
groups.title: Tools and Retrieval for Agents
groups.description: Core interfaces for tools that agents can utilize to perform actions and for retrieval systems that fetch relevant documents.

groups.label: Data Storage
groups.title: Vector Data Management
groups.description: The interface for managing and querying vector embeddings, crucial for retrieval-augmented generation and semantic search.

callbacks_and_tracing.title: Callbacks and Tracing
callbacks_and_tracing.description: This module provides core functionalities for handling asynchronous and synchronous callbacks, managing execution traces, and dispatching custom events within LangChain applications. It enables detailed logging, monitoring, and integration with tracing platforms like LangSmith.

nodes.label: LLM, Chain, Tool, Agent, Retriever Components
nodes.title: Operational Components
nodes.description: Represents the various LangChain components (LLMs, Chains, Tools, Agents, Retrievers) that generate events during their execution, which are then processed by callback handlers and tracers.

nodes.label: Define Asynchronous Event Handlers
nodes.title: Asynchronous Callback Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class defining asynchronous methods for handling various events (start, end, error, new token) across LLM, chain, tool, agent, and retriever runs. It serves as the foundation for custom async callback logic.

nodes.label: Log Events to File
nodes.title: File Logging Callback
nodes.description: A concrete callback handler that writes detailed event logs (chain start/end, agent actions, tool outputs, text) to a specified file, supporting both append and write modes. It can be used as a context manager for proper file handling.

nodes.label: Group Synchronous Operations for Tracing
nodes.title: Synchronous Chain Group Tracing
nodes.description: A synchronous context manager that groups multiple related operations into a single logical 'chain group' run for tracing purposes, facilitating organized monitoring in platforms like LangSmith.

nodes.label: Group Asynchronous Operations for Tracing
nodes.title: Asynchronous Chain Group Tracing
nodes.description: An asynchronous context manager that groups multiple related asynchronous operations into a single logical 'chain group' run for tracing, enabling structured monitoring of concurrent processes.

nodes.label: Dispatch Synchronous Custom Events
nodes.title: Synchronous Custom Event Dispatcher
nodes.description: A utility function to synchronously dispatch ad-hoc custom events to registered callback handlers, allowing for flexible, user-defined event signaling within an existing run context.

nodes.label: Dispatch Asynchronous Custom Events
nodes.title: Asynchronous Custom Event Dispatcher
nodes.description: A utility function to asynchronously dispatch ad-hoc custom events to registered callback handlers, supporting flexible, user-defined event signaling within an existing asynchronous run context.

nodes.label: Collect LLM Usage Metadata
nodes.title: Usage Metadata Collector
nodes.description: A context manager that provides a callback handler to track and aggregate usage metadata, such as token counts, from chat model calls, offering insights into resource consumption.

nodes.label: Collect All Traced Runs
nodes.title: Run Collector Context Manager
nodes.description: A context manager that captures and stores all LangChain runs (LLM calls, chain executions, tool invocations) that occur within its scope, providing a programmatic way to access run data.

nodes.label: Manage Run Lifecycle & Tracing Data
nodes.title: Abstract Tracing Core
nodes.description: An abstract base class that defines the fundamental logic for creating, updating, and managing the lifecycle of runs (LLM, chain, tool, retriever) and their associated events, including handling parent-child relationships and error reporting for tracing.

nodes.label: Process Streaming Output for Tracing
nodes.title: Asynchronous Stream Consumer
nodes.description: An asynchronous function that consumes a stream of output chunks from a runnable, reconstructs the evolving final output, and dispatches `RunLogPatch` events for real-time logging and UI updates during streaming operations.

nodes.label: LangSmith Tracing Platform
nodes.title: External Tracing Service
nodes.description: An external platform for visualizing, debugging, and evaluating LangChain applications by collecting and displaying detailed run traces and metadata.

nodes.label: Local File System
nodes.title: Local Storage
nodes.description: The local storage where the FileCallbackHandler writes its logs and event data.

groups.label: User-Facing Utilities
groups.title: User-Facing Utilities
groups.description: Components that provide direct utility to users for logging, collecting run data, or tracking specific metrics.

groups.label: Event/Run Initiation
groups.title: Event/Run Initiation
groups.description: Components responsible for initiating new runs, grouping operations, or dispatching custom events within the callback and tracing system.

groups.label: Core Tracing Logic
groups.title: Core Tracing Logic
groups.description: Abstract and concrete components that manage the internal state, lifecycle, and processing of tracing data.

groups.label: Callback Interface
groups.title: Callback Interface
groups.description: The foundational abstract class for defining how asynchronous events are handled across the system.

general_utilities.title: General Core Utilities
general_utilities.description: This module provides a collection of fundamental utility functions and classes, including tools for managing data streams, parsing HTML, handling Pydantic models, validating arguments, reporting system information, and in-memory caching. It offers essential building blocks for various framework operations.

nodes.label: Split Async Iterator
nodes.title: Asynchronous Iterator Tee
nodes.description: Provides a mechanism to create multiple independent asynchronous iterators from a single source. It buffers items, ensuring all child iterators receive the same sequence of elements, suitable for concurrent processing of a single data stream.

nodes.label: Extract & Filter HTML Links
nodes.title: HTML Link Extractor
nodes.description: Parses HTML content to extract and normalize embedded links, converting them to absolute URLs. It includes filtering capabilities to restrict links to a base URL or exclude specific prefixes, useful for web content analysis.

nodes.label: Split Synchronous Iterator
nodes.title: Synchronous Iterator Tee
nodes.description: Generates multiple independent synchronous iterators from a single iterable source. It buffers elements to ensure consistent data delivery across all child iterators, enabling parallel or sequential processing of a single data stream.

nodes.label: Pydantic Model Init Wrapper
nodes.title: Pydantic Init Wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that enhances Pydantic model initialization by handling default field values and enabling population of fields using their alias names, streamlining model creation.

nodes.label: Get Pydantic Version
nodes.title: Pydantic Version Getter
nodes.description: Retrieves the major version number of the installed Pydantic library, primarily for compatibility checks. Note: This function is deprecated.

nodes.label: Argument Validation Decorator
nodes.title: Exclusive Argument Validator
nodes.description: A decorator that enforces a constraint where exactly one argument within specified groups must be provided (non-None) to a function, ensuring valid parameter combinations.

nodes.label: Print System Information
nodes.title: System Information Reporter
nodes.description: Collects and displays comprehensive system and package details, including OS, Python version, and installed LangChain libraries, for debugging and environment assessment.

nodes.label: In-Memory LLM Cache
nodes.title: LLM Response Cache
nodes.description: An efficient in-memory cache for storing and retrieving Language Model (LLM) responses. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations and can be configured with a maximum size to manage memory usage.

groups.label: Surface Utilities
groups.title: General Purpose Utilities
groups.description: Contains decorators and helper functions for common programming patterns and environment checks.

groups.label: Analytical Tools
groups.title: Analysis and Reporting
groups.description: Provides tools for analyzing content (like HTML) and reporting on the system environment.

groups.label: Data Stream Management
groups.title: Iterator Management
groups.description: Components designed for splitting and managing both synchronous and asynchronous data streams.

groups.label: Data Storage
groups.title: Caching Mechanisms
groups.description: Includes an in-memory caching solution for efficient storage and retrieval of LLM responses.

core_framework.title: Core Framework Overview
core_framework.description: This module defines the fundamental building blocks, interfaces, and essential utilities that form the foundation of the LangChain ecosystem. It provides core abstractions for AI components, manages API lifecycle, ensures security, and offers observability features.

nodes.label: Define Core Interfaces
nodes.title: Fundamental LangChain Abstractions
nodes.description: Establishes the foundational abstract classes and interfaces for building all LangChain components, including runnables, language models, prompts, and tools. It forms the architectural backbone.

nodes.label: Manage API & Security
nodes.title: API Lifecycle & Security Utilities
nodes.description: Provides mechanisms for managing API deprecations and beta features, alongside robust security measures like SSRF protection for URL validation and secure HTTP client creation.

nodes.label: Handle Events & Tracing
nodes.title: Observability with Callbacks & Tracing
nodes.description: Offers core functionalities for handling synchronous and asynchronous events, managing execution traces, and dispatching custom events for monitoring and debugging LangChain applications.

nodes.label: Provide General Utilities
nodes.title: Essential General Utilities
nodes.description: Contains a collection of fundamental utility functions and classes for tasks such as data stream management, HTML parsing, Pydantic model handling, system information, and in-memory caching.

groups.label: Core Foundation
groups.title: Core Framework Foundation
groups.description: This group represents the central abstract definitions and interfaces that all other LangChain components are built upon, providing the fundamental structure and behavior.

groups.label: Cross-Cutting Services
groups.title: Cross-Cutting Framework Services
groups.description: These modules provide essential services that span across various components of the framework, such as managing API lifecycle, ensuring security, and offering comprehensive observability features.

groups.label: General Support
groups.title: General Framework Support Utilities
groups.description: This group encompasses a collection of versatile utility functions and classes that support the overall framework, aiding in common tasks like data manipulation, system diagnostics, and caching.

model_implementations.title: Fake Language Model Implementations
model_implementations.description: This module provides various fake chat model implementations for testing and development purposes, allowing simulation of LLM responses and streaming behavior. It includes utilities for managing LLM retry callbacks.

nodes.label: Simulate Chat with Response List
nodes.title: Fake Chat Model with Response List
nodes.description: A test chat model that cycles through a predefined list of string responses. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous calls, including streaming, and can simulate errors during chunk generation. Useful for controlled testing of LLM interactions.

nodes.label: Provide Generic Fake Chat Response
nodes.title: Generic Fake Chat Model
nodes.description: A basic fake chat model designed for simple testing scenarios. It consistently returns a fixed 'fake response' string, providing a predictable output for unit tests and quick validations of chat model integrations.

nodes.label: Simulate Chat with Message List
nodes.title: Fake Chat Model with Message List
nodes.description: A test chat model that cycles through a predefined list of BaseMessage objects. This allows for more complex and structured fake responses compared to simple strings, enabling detailed testing of message-based chat flows.

nodes.label: Echo Last Input Message
nodes.title: Parrot Fake Chat Model
nodes.description: A straightforward fake chat model that returns the last received BaseMessage as its response. This model is useful for testing scenarios where the output should directly reflect the input, such as identity transformations or simple conversational loops.

nodes.label: Manage LLM Retry Callbacks
nodes.title: LLM Retry Callback Handler
nodes.description: A utility function responsible for managing callbacks during LLM retry attempts. It ensures that on_retry events are properly dispatched to both synchronous and asynchronous callback managers, handling background tasks for async calls.

nodes.label: Base Chat Model Interface
nodes.title: Base Chat Model Abstraction
nodes.description: The foundational abstract class for all chat models, defining the core interface and methods for interacting with conversational AI systems. It provides the blueprint for concrete chat model implementations.

nodes.label: Simple Chat Model Interface
nodes.title: Simple Chat Model Abstraction
nodes.description: A simplified abstract chat model class that extends the BaseChatModel. It provides a basic structure for chat models, often used as an intermediate base for more specific implementations, simplifying the required overrides.

nodes.label: Represent Chat Message
nodes.title: Base Chat Message
nodes.description: An abstract base class representing a single message within a chat conversation. It serves as the foundation for various message types (e.g., human, AI, system) and ensures consistent handling of conversational data.

nodes.label: Represent Chat Generation Result
nodes.title: Chat Generation Result
nodes.description: A data structure encapsulating the outcome of a chat model generation request. It typically contains a list of ChatGeneration objects, each representing a potential response from the model.

nodes.label: Represent Streaming Chat Chunk
nodes.title: Streaming Chat Generation Chunk
nodes.description: A data structure representing a partial response or a chunk of content received during a streaming chat model interaction. It allows for incremental processing of LLM outputs.

nodes.label: Represent AI Message Chunk
nodes.title: AI Message Streaming Chunk
nodes.description: A specific type of BaseMessage chunk representing a partial message generated by an AI model during a streaming response. It contains the content and potentially the chunk's position in the stream.

nodes.label: Represent AI Message
nodes.title: AI Generated Message
nodes.description: A concrete implementation of BaseMessage representing a message generated by an AI model. It typically contains the AI's textual response and can include additional metadata.

nodes.label: Runnable Configuration
nodes.title: Runnable Execution Configuration
nodes.description: A configuration object used to control the execution behavior of Runnable components. It can specify parameters like callbacks, tags, metadata, and other settings for a particular run.

nodes.label: Handle LLM Callbacks (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous LLM Callback Manager
nodes.description: Manages and dispatches synchronous callbacks during the execution of an LLM run. It allows for custom logic to be injected at various stages of the LLM's lifecycle, such as on_retry events.

nodes.label: Handle LLM Callbacks (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous LLM Callback Manager
nodes.description: Manages and dispatches asynchronous callbacks during the execution of an LLM run. It supports non-blocking custom logic at different stages of the LLM's lifecycle, including handling on_retry events asynchronously.

groups.label: Fake Chat Models
groups.title: Fake Chat Model Implementations
groups.description: This group encompasses various fake chat model implementations designed for testing and development, offering different simulation behaviors for LLM interactions.

groups.label: LLM Utilities
groups.title: LLM Utility Functions
groups.description: This group contains utility functions that support LLM operations, such as managing retry callbacks during model invocations.

message_handling.title: Message Handling & Translation
message_handling.description: This module provides core functionalities for handling messages, including translating LLM provider-specific content into a standardized format, constructing various content blocks, and offering utilities for message manipulation and chat history management.

nodes.label: Register Block Translators
nodes.title: Register Block Translators
nodes.description: Initializes and registers various LLM provider-specific content block translators within the framework, enabling standardized message processing.

nodes.label: Anthropic LLM
nodes.title: Anthropic LLM
nodes.description: An external language model provider that generates messages in its native format, requiring translation for internal use.

nodes.label: Anthropic Block Iterator
nodes.title: Anthropic Block Iterator
nodes.description: Iterates and converts Anthropic-specific content blocks (text, tool_use, reasoning, server_tool_use, mcp_tool_use) into a standardized internal format, handling streaming chunks and full messages.

nodes.label: Bedrock LLM
nodes.title: Bedrock LLM
nodes.description: An external language model provider (e.g., Anthropic models via Bedrock) that generates messages in its native format.

nodes.label: Bedrock Content Translator
nodes.title: Bedrock Content Translator
nodes.description: Translates full AI messages from Bedrock (specifically Anthropic models) into a list of standard content blocks for unified processing.

nodes.label: Bedrock Chunk Translator
nodes.title: Bedrock Chunk Translator
nodes.description: Translates streaming AI message chunks from Bedrock into a list of standard content blocks, primarily for Anthropic models, enabling real-time processing.

nodes.label: Bedrock Converse Block Iterator
nodes.title: Bedrock Converse Block Iterator
nodes.description: Iterates and converts Bedrock Converse-specific content blocks (text, reasoning_content, tool_use) into a standardized internal format, handling streaming chunks and full messages.

nodes.label: Google GenAI LLM
nodes.title: Google GenAI LLM
nodes.description: An external language model provider from Google that generates messages in its native format.

nodes.label: Google GenAI Content Translator
nodes.title: Google GenAI Content Translator
nodes.description: Translates full AI messages from Google GenAI into a list of standard content blocks, ensuring compatibility with the framework's message structure.

nodes.label: Google GenAI Chunk Translator
nodes.title: Google GenAI Chunk Translator
nodes.description: Translates streaming AI message chunks from Google GenAI into a list of standard content blocks, facilitating incremental message processing.

nodes.label: Groq LLM
nodes.title: Groq LLM
nodes.description: An external language model provider from Groq that generates messages in its native format.

nodes.label: Groq Content Translator
nodes.title: Groq Content Translator
nodes.description: Translates full AI messages from Groq into a list of standard content blocks, enabling consistent handling across different LLMs.

nodes.label: Groq Chunk Translator
nodes.title: Groq Chunk Translator
nodes.description: Translates streaming AI message chunks from Groq into a list of standard content blocks, supporting efficient stream processing.

nodes.label: OpenAI LLM
nodes.title: OpenAI LLM
nodes.description: An external language model provider from OpenAI that generates messages in its native format.

nodes.label: OpenAI Content Translator
nodes.title: OpenAI Content Translator
nodes.description: Translates full AI messages from OpenAI into a list of standard content blocks, handling both string and structured content for broad compatibility.

nodes.label: OpenAI Chunk Translator
nodes.title: OpenAI Chunk Translator
nodes.description: Translates streaming AI message chunks from OpenAI into a list of standard content blocks, supporting incremental updates during generation.

nodes.label: OpenAI Block Iterator
nodes.title: OpenAI Block Iterator
nodes.description: Iterates and converts OpenAI-specific content blocks (text, reasoning, image_generation_call, function_call, web_search_call, file_search_call, code_interpreter_call, mcp_call, mcp_list_tools, tool_search_call/output) into a standardized internal format, managing various tool and server calls.

nodes.label: OpenAI Chat Completions Input Converter
nodes.title: OpenAI Chat Completions Input Converter
nodes.description: Converts OpenAI Chat Completions format blocks, including non-standard ones, into the internal v1 ContentBlock format, ensuring proper interpretation.

nodes.label: Create Text Block
nodes.title: Create Text Block
nodes.description: Constructs a standardized text content block with optional ID, annotations, and index, facilitating the creation of rich text messages.

nodes.label: Create Image Block
nodes.title: Create Image Block
nodes.description: Constructs a standardized image content block from URL, base64 data, or file ID, with optional MIME type and ID, for multimedia message creation.

nodes.label: Create Video Block
nodes.title: Create Video Block
nodes.description: Constructs a standardized video content block from URL, base64 data, or file ID, with optional MIME type and ID, for multimedia message creation.

nodes.label: Create Audio Block
nodes.title: Create Audio Block
nodes.description: Constructs a standardized audio content block from URL, base64 data, or file ID, with optional MIME type and ID, for multimedia message creation.

nodes.label: Create File Block
nodes.title: Create File Block
nodes.description: Constructs a standardized file content block from URL, base64 data, or file ID, with optional MIME type and ID, for attaching files to messages.

nodes.label: Create Plaintext Block
nodes.title: Create Plaintext Block
nodes.description: Constructs a standardized plaintext content block, supporting text, URL, base64, file ID, title, and context, for flexible text representation.

nodes.label: Create Reasoning Block
nodes.title: Create Reasoning Block
nodes.description: Constructs a standardized reasoning content block with optional reasoning text and ID, useful for representing LLM thought processes.

nodes.label: Create Non-Standard Block
nodes.title: Create Non-Standard Block
nodes.description: Constructs a block for provider-specific content that doesn't fit standard types, preserving its original value for later interpretation or debugging.

nodes.label: Approximate Token Counter
nodes.title: Approximate Token Counter
nodes.description: Estimates the number of tokens in a sequence of messages, providing a quick metric for cost or length management without exact tokenization.

nodes.label: Runnable Wrapper
nodes.title: Runnable Wrapper
nodes.description: Wraps a function to make it compatible with the Runnable interface, allowing it to be seamlessly integrated into LangChain expression language chains.

nodes.label: Merge Message Runs
nodes.title: Merge Message Runs
nodes.description: Combines consecutive messages of the same type into a single message, concatenating content with a specified separator for cleaner message history.

nodes.label: Filter Messages
nodes.title: Filter Messages
nodes.description: Filters a list of messages based on criteria such as name, type, ID, or tool call IDs, allowing for selective message processing.

nodes.label: Truncate Last Messages
nodes.title: Truncate Last Messages
nodes.description: Selects a subset of messages from the end, ensuring the total token count does not exceed a specified maximum, optionally preserving system messages.

nodes.label: In-Memory Chat History
nodes.title: In-Memory Chat History
nodes.description: Provides an in-memory storage and retrieval mechanism for chat messages, supporting asynchronous operations for quick access to conversation history.

nodes.label: Base Message Abstraction
nodes.title: Base Message Abstraction
nodes.description: The fundamental abstraction for all message types in the LangChain framework, providing a common interface for message content and metadata.

nodes.label: Standard Content Block
nodes.title: Standard Content Block
nodes.description: A standardized representation for various types of content within messages (text, image, tool calls, etc.), enabling uniform processing.

nodes.label: Prompt Value
nodes.title: Prompt Value
nodes.description: Represents a prompt that can be converted into a list of messages, serving as input for language models.

nodes.label: Runnable Interface
nodes.title: Runnable Interface
nodes.description: A core abstraction for composable units of logic in LangChain, allowing for flexible and modular chain construction.

groups.label: LLM Provider Content Translation
groups.title: LLM Provider Content Translation
groups.description: Handles the conversion of messages from various LLM providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, Google GenAI, Groq, OpenAI) into a standardized internal content block format, ensuring interoperability.

groups.label: Standard Content Block Construction
groups.title: Standard Content Block Construction
groups.description: Provides functions for programmatically creating various types of standardized content blocks, such as text, images, videos, audio, files, plaintext, reasoning, and non-standard data.

groups.label: Message Utility Functions
groups.title: Message Utility Functions
groups.description: Offers a suite of utilities for manipulating messages, including token counting, filtering, merging consecutive messages, and truncating message history.

groups.label: Chat History Management
groups.title: Chat History Management
groups.description: Manages the storage and retrieval of chat messages in memory, providing a simple yet effective way to maintain conversation context.

prompt_engineering.title: Prompt Engineering Components
prompt_engineering.description: This module provides various prompt template classes for constructing and managing prompts, including chat-based, string-based, few-shot, and structured output prompts. It also includes utilities for loading and formatting prompts, enabling flexible prompt creation for language models.

nodes.label: Define Message Prompt Structure
nodes.title: BaseMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all message-based prompt templates, defining the interface for formatting messages and handling input variables.

nodes.label: Define String Prompt Structure
nodes.title: StringPromptTemplate
nodes.description: Abstract base class for string-based prompt templates, providing methods to format prompts into strings or StringPromptValue objects.

nodes.label: Format Individual Chat Message
nodes.title: ChatMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: Formats a single chat message with a specified role (e.g., 'human', 'AI') and content, based on a prompt template.

nodes.label: Format AI Message
nodes.title: AIMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: A specialized chat message prompt template for messages originating from an AI.

nodes.label: Format System Message
nodes.title: SystemMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: A specialized chat message prompt template for system-level instructions or context, not directly shown to the user.

nodes.label: Create Few-Shot Chat Prompt
nodes.title: FewShotChatMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: Generates a list of chat messages by incorporating few-shot examples, which can be fixed or dynamically selected, into a conversation flow.

nodes.label: Create Few-Shot String Prompt
nodes.title: FewShotPromptWithTemplates
nodes.description: Constructs a string-based prompt by embedding few-shot examples, using a prefix, suffix, and an example selector or fixed examples.

memory_management.title: Memory Management Strategies
